selection: Complete FASTQ rows for eleven filename-prefix and Tempus alias locations, their parent-directory inventory entries, and the complete sample registry. Parsed source excerpts; original values retained.

fastqs.notes: CeGaT tumor RNA (STAR 2.7.3a, hg19). Sequenced 2023-03-22 on the T0 material collected 2022-12-16. Files live under P116686_2_S000048/ despite the P116686_3 sample id.
CeGaT tumor DNA (exome kit S000048, hg19). Sequenced 2023-03-22 on the T0 material collected 2022-12-16. Ships _somatic.tsv; source data for the CeGaT neoantigen vaccine.

Natera/Ashion hybrid-capture tumour DNA (WES-like; @RG CN:ASHION, LB I006353-01D-01L, SM ..._TumorDNA). Case 9759206 (Altera WES) or 8592254 (Signatera WES): the delivery does not say which. GRCh37 hs37d5, contigs 1, 2, ... (no chr prefix). Not as delivered: FASTQ regenerated in this project from vendor/natera/28578842.1-2-FXG_C069-018634_WF00085349_I006353-01D-01L_TumorDNA.bam (samtools collate + fastq; secondary and supplementary alignments dropped, duplicates kept), 258,112,616 read pairs. Natera delivered no FASTQ.
Tempus xE whole exome, tumour; GRCh37. Byte-identical to the catalog copy under rna-seq/tempus/TL-24-ALMY2X4KMV/WES/. Tumor and normal share one FastQ/ directory, so the row key appends /T.

fastqs.display_name: T0 Natera Tumor WGS 2022-12 (case 17849104 0198480a, tumour inferred)
fastqs.notes: Natera WGS, case 17849104; GRCh37 hs37d5, contigs chr1, chr2, ... Tumour is INFERRED, not vendor-confirmed: the BAM's @RG SM is only its UUID; at heterozygous sites only 8% of allele fractions sit near 0.5 (they pile up at 0.20-0.25), and it is ~123x deep against ~45x for the 0196b23b normal, on a separate flowcell. Confirm before somatic use. Not as delivered: FASTQ regenerated in this project from vendor/natera/0198480a-d9d5-7fe4-baed-4d696baf665b.bam (samtools collate + fastq; secondary and supplementary alignments dropped, duplicates kept), 1,447,357,058 read pairs. Natera delivered no FASTQ.
CeGaT normal DNA (exome kit S000048, hg19, chrY PAR masked). Sequenced 2023-03-22 on the T0 material collected 2022-12-16. Source data for the CeGaT peptide neoantigen vaccine.

Natera/Ashion hybrid-capture germline DNA (WES-like; @RG CN:ASHION, LB i005199-01D-01L, SM ..._GermlineDNA), the normal for the Ashion tumour; its source and draw date are not recorded, so it is filed with T0_blood. Case 9759206 (Altera WES) or 8592254 (Signatera WES): the delivery does not say which. GRCh37 hs37d5, contigs 1, 2, ... (no chr prefix). Not as delivered: FASTQ regenerated in this project from vendor/natera/28578183.3-2-BXE_C069-018634_WF00085349_i005199-01D-01L_GermlineDNA.bam (samtools collate + fastq; secondary and supplementary alignments dropped, duplicates kept), 123,411,122 read pairs. Natera delivered no FASTQ.

fastqs.display_name: T0 Natera Blood WGS 2022-12 (case 17849104 0196b23b, normal inferred)
fastqs.notes: Natera WGS, case 17849104: the germline normal, INFERRED, not vendor-confirmed (the BAM's @RG SM is only its UUID; allele fractions at heterozygous sites peak at 0.45-0.50, ~45x). Whether it is blood or adjacent normal tissue, and when it was collected, is not recorded; filed with T0_blood. GRCh37 hs37d5, contigs chr1, chr2, ... Confirm before somatic use. Not as delivered: FASTQ regenerated in this project from vendor/natera/0196b23b-c139-7fb0-91ff-65f19670d743.bam (samtools collate + fastq; secondary and supplementary alignments dropped, duplicates kept), 494,239,896 read pairs. Natera delivered no FASTQ.

UCLA T1 tumour RNA-seq from the 2024-06-06 CT-guided biopsy (PREMOST SARC0277; same UCLA sample name and flowcell lane 227V5CLT4:6 as the T1 WGS). The patient (somalier run 5; 0.7% foreign alleles). Untrimmed 2x150: trim adapters before aligning. Reprocessed as rna-seq/reprocessed/SARC0277_T1/.

fastqs.display_name: T2 UCLA Organoid WGS 2025-01 (SARC0277_3 ORGANOID vendor)
fastqs.notes: UCLA T2 organoid WGS (organoid of the 2025-01-28 T2 biopsy SARC0277_3; library dated 02-02-25). The patient (somalier IBS0 0; PURPLE contamination 0). About 1.3% mouse reads (culture matrix), adapter dimers and poly-G tails: trim and remove mouse reads before variant calling.

Germline normal for the Tempus xE/xT tests of the T0 tumour; blood drawn 2024-09-21. GRCh37. Byte-identical to the catalog copy under rna-seq/tempus/TL-24-ALMY2X4KMV/WES/. Tumor and normal share one FastQ/ directory, so the row key appends /N.
